numberingNote: Objective numbers 1.1–7.3 are a study convention; the official guide lists objectives as unnumbered bullets.

objectives.text: Translate business problems into Claude-based AI solutions
objectives.short: Translate business problems into Claude solutions
archetypes: Sponsor asks for 'a chatbot': BEST first framing of the underlying job
Map a pain point to no-AI / augmented call / workflow
Which success measure proves the solution solved the stated problem

objectives.text: Design end-to-end architectures (input → processing → output → feedback loops)
archetypes: Which missing component closes the feedback loop
Select TWO components the design needs for the stated constraint
A 2s legacy timeout calls for an async job or callback pattern

objectives.text: Select appropriate architectural patterns (workflow, agentic, augmented LLM)
objectives.short: Select patterns: workflow, agentic, augmented LLM
archetypes: Fixed path plus audit trail: workflow vs agent
One-step task: augmented call is enough
Counter-trap: runtime-emergent steps with recoverable errors justify an agent

objectives.text: Design multi-agent systems and orchestration strategies
archetypes: Orchestrator-workers vs a single agent with tools
Context handoff: what the subagent must receive
Counter-trap: independent parallel research justifies subagents

objectives.text: Apply decomposition techniques for complex problem solving
archetypes: Chaining vs sectioning vs routing for independent aspects
Split by dependency and independence, not by team
Select TWO decomposition steps that fix the observed failure

objectives.text: Align solutions to business value pillars (efficiency, transformation, productivity, cost, performance SLAs)
objectives.short: Align to value pillars (efficiency, transformation, productivity, cost, performance SLAs)
archetypes: 'Per person' vs 'per unit': which pillar the evidence supports
Which metric evidences transformation rather than efficiency
Performance SLA framed as a pillar for an executive sponsor

objectives.text: Select appropriate Claude models based on trade-offs
archetypes: Tier routing by task complexity under a cost ceiling
p95 latency SLA vs reasoning depth
Counter-trap: failures only on complex reasoning justify a higher tier

objectives.text: Design system prompts, templates, and guardrails
archetypes: What belongs in the system prompt vs in code enforcement
Template variables vs hard-coded per-customer prompts
Select TWO guardrails: preventive + detective

objectives.text: Apply prompt engineering techniques (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought)
archetypes: Format drift calls for few-shot examples
Multi-step arithmetic or logic errors call for structured reasoning
Zero-shot is enough: do not add examples that bias the output

objectives.text: Optimize context windows and manage token usage
archetypes: Cost and recall degrade together: reduce what enters the context
Long sessions: compaction or summarisation vs truncation
Select TWO: tool-result clearing plus relevance filtering

objectives.text: Implement prompt reuse strategies (caching, modular prompts, Skills)
objectives.short: Prompt reuse: caching, modular prompts, Skills
archetypes: Static prefix first, then caching
A timestamp before the breakpoint breaks cache hits
Skill vs MCP vs shared prompt module for reusable know-how

objectives.text: Evaluate tool/agent configuration for capability bloat
archetypes: The role only reads and drafts: remove the write tools
200 tools and wrong picks: scope per role
Select TWO fixes for mis-selection without a mega-tool

objectives.text: Analyze authentication and authorization requirements to identify security gaps
archetypes: Shared service account: act with the user's permissions
External rollout: where authorization must be enforced
Select TWO: preventive authz plus detective audit

objectives.text: Evaluate accuracy-latency trade-offs and justify configuration decisions
archetypes: Streaming vs completion time
Re-rank cost vs a p95 budget
Route easy queries to a fast tier and keep the accuracy floor

objectives.text: Analyze observability challenges and select monitoring strategies at scale
archetypes: What a trace must capture (prompt and model version, retrieved ids, tool calls)
Sampling strategy at 1M requests/day without losing failures
Select TWO signals that let the team localise a regression

objectives.text: Design a RAG pipeline with appropriate chunking and indexing strategies
archetypes: Clause cut mid-chunk: chunk on unit boundaries
Chunks lose context: add contextual headers or metadata
Live claim status belongs in the system of record, not the index

objectives.text: Apply retrieval strategies matched to data shape and query pattern
objectives.short: Retrieval strategies by data shape and query pattern
archetypes: Identifiers go lexical, concepts go semantic, mixed traffic is routed hybrid
High recall but low precision: re-rank
Select TWO: filter before search plus routing by query shape

objectives.text: Evaluate connection protocols and select the appropriate integration mechanism (MCP, API/CLI, agent-to-agent)
archetypes: Three surfaces need the same capability: MCP
A one-off fixed pipeline: direct API
Cross-organisation negotiation between independently reasoning systems: agent-to-agent

objectives.text: Evaluate progressive discovery vs. monolithic context strategy
archetypes: Large tool catalogue: deferred loading or tool search
Skills: metadata first, body loaded on trigger
Counter-trap: a small, stable catalogue is fine loaded up front

objectives.text: Define evaluation metrics (accuracy, latency, cost, safety, security)
objectives.short: Evaluation metrics (accuracy, latency, cost, safety, security)
archetypes: Pick a metric set with pre-agreed thresholds
Security and safety metrics for an agent with tool access
Select TWO metrics that decide the go/no-go

objectives.text: Design evaluation datasets and test frameworks using mixed methodologies
archetypes: Judge score up while complaints rise: recalibrate against human labels
Eval steady while regional errors rise: refresh the set and add a slice
Grading ladder: code check, then rubric judge, then expert review

objectives.text: Conduct A/B testing and iterative improvements
archetypes: 'Winner after 50 sessions': pre-registered stopping rule
One change per arm
Guardrail metrics that stop a rollout

objectives.text: Diagnose system issues (prompt failure, hallucinations, model mismatch)
objectives.short: Diagnose issues: prompt failure, hallucination, model mismatch
archetypes: After a doc refresh, model and latency unchanged: MOST likely cause
Right docs, wrong answer (grounding) vs wrong docs (retrieval)
Fails only on complex items (tier) vs fails uniformly (prompt)

objectives.text: Optimize token usage, latency, and cost-performance trade-offs
archetypes: Measure the dominant term first
Overnight reports: Batch API
Select TWO levers that cut cost without breaching the accuracy floor

objectives.text: Monitor system performance using logging and observability tools
archetypes: Drift alert design with a baseline and thresholds
What to log under PII constraints
Nothing was deployed but quality dropped: FIRST step

objectives.text: Implement guardrails and safety controls
archetypes: Control-strength ladder: pick the strongest sufficient rung
Input and output screening vs tool removal
Select TWO: preventive + detective pairing

objectives.text: Identify risks, limitations, and failure modes of LLM systems
archetypes: Prompt injection via retrieved documents
Failure-mode analysis before a pilot
Graceful fallback when a dependency fails

objectives.text: Apply human-in-the-loop validation strategies
archetypes: Route review by reversibility × blast radius
'Model says 95% sure' is not a trigger
4-second approvals: fix the rubber stamp

objectives.text: Ensure compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP)
archetypes: PHI workload: BAA and eligible configuration, not ZDR alone
EU full customer profiles: minimise the payload
Select TWO: data-residency control plus evidence artefact

objectives.text: Address ethical AI considerations (bias, fairness, transparency)
archetypes: Aggregate fine, subgroup failing: slice evaluation
AI disclosure to end users
A fairness trade-off decided by the accountable owner

objectives.text: Conduct structured discovery and requirement gathering
archetypes: FIRST discovery output: baseline, target, constraints, owner
Hidden constraint surfaced by the right question
Select TWO discovery artefacts before any build

objectives.text: Communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs
archetypes: Exec wants 99.9%: reframe with a trade-off curve
Board briefing: decision, impact, risk, ask
Select TWO actions when the accuracy bar is missed

objectives.text: Manage stakeholder feedback loops and expectation alignment (including SLAs)
archetypes: SLA formulation: p95 at peak, accuracy floor, error budget
User feedback channel feeding the eval set
Select TWO SLA clauses that survive peak season

objectives.text: Document architectures and provide implementation guidance
archetypes: Preserve the reasoning: ADR
Handoff package for the operating team
A chat channel or contact person is not documentation

objectives.text: Support lifecycle phases (discovery, design, handoff, monitoring, iteration)
objectives.short: Lifecycle phases: discovery, design, handoff, monitoring, iteration
archetypes: POC vs pilot vs production exit criteria
Failed pilot with no criteria: define criteria before retrying
What happens after handoff: monitoring ownership

objectives.text: Configure Claude tools and environments for teams (e.g., Claude Code)
objectives.short: Configure Claude tools/environments for teams (e.g. Claude Code)
archetypes: 'Cannot be disabled on any machine': managed settings
Configs drift across teams: committed project config
Select TWO: a fail-closed hook plus a deny rule for a sensitive path

objectives.text: Improve developer workflows using AI-assisted tooling
objectives.short: Improve developer workflows with AI tooling
archetypes: Prove the rollout worked: outcome vs baseline, not seats
Headless CI run with an allowlist
Where AI assistance fits in the review workflow

objectives.text: Support debugging and operational issue resolution
archetypes: MCP server failing for one team: FIRST diagnostic
Permission-denied after a settings rollout: which scope wins
Pull traces before widening access or failing over
